title: Course credentials: Attended from the live Run, Certified from a reviewed Community Book, each public by id with a badge

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-17: Send in your Community Book, filled in from real gatherings, and Frequency reviews it for Certified

detail: Split from JRN-017 (owner 2026-11-18). course_credentials and community_book_submissions (migration 20270346092000, service role only). Attended: when the follow-up cron reaches the last session of a Run (details.runKey), everyone marked as at every session gets the Attended credential and one email (deduped on the credential id). Certified: the signed-in learner sends a Community Book from /courses/<slug>/certify (offersCertified courses only); a Frequency reviewer decides it from the Community Books queue on /admin/content/journeys (authorizeAction admin or community, parseInput zod), and the learner gets the credential or the note. Every credential is public at /credentials/<id> (noindex) with /credentials/<id>/badge.svg. The credential email builds its text without stripping HTML (CodeQL finding on #5218).
